newsitem.title: USA: Norwest authorized share increase approved.
newsitem.headline: Norwest authorized share increase approved.

text.p: Norwest Corp shareholders at the financial services company's annual meeting here on Tuesday voted to approve an increase in the authorized common stock to 1.0 billion shares from 500 million.

Norwest President Richard Kovacevich told shareholders the increased shares could be used for acquisitions and employee stock option plans. In the proxy, Norwest also said the shares could be used for stock dividends and splits, raising additional capital, stockholder stock plans and for measures to block changes in control. Norwest already has a shareholder rights plan.
"The additional shares may be used by the corporation for a variety of purposes, including acquisitions and employee stock option plans," Kovacevich said.

Two shareholder proposals seeking the board members be elected by cumulative voting and asking the board to develop a fair-lending policy did not receive a majority of shareholder votes represented at the meeting. The exact tally was not given.
